data.body_html:
Combine the thrill of sport fishing with the romance of a sunset cruise on the Costa del Sol. Our marbella fishing and sunset combo charter 2049 departs from Puerto Banús, taking you into the Mediterranean for a few hours of angling, then back along the coast as the sky turns gold. With a licensed skipper, all gear, and drinks included, it’s the most relaxed way to spend an afternoon on the water.

Why choose the combo charter?

Fishing trips alone can be intense; sunset cruises alone can be passive. This combo gives you both in one seamless outing. You’ll head out to proven fishing grounds, drop lines for bonito or dorado, then cruise back with a glass of cava in hand. The whole experience lasts between 2 and 8 hours, depending on your preference.

Boats and pricing

Our standard combo runs on the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 passengers) or Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 passengers), both departing from Puerto Banús. Pricing is straightforward:

DurationPrice (all inclusive)
2 hours€749
4 hours€1,299
6 hours€1,799
8 hours€2,299

All prices include skipper, fuel, fishing gear, drinks, snacks, insurance, and IVA. For larger groups, we can arrange the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) with a minimum 4-hour charter at €4,719 – that includes a free jet ski. For other yachts, message us on WhatsApp for a custom quote.

What’s included in every charter

  • Licensed, experienced skipper
  • Fuel and full insurance
  • Fishing rods, reels, and bait
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, and cava
  • Light snacks (olives, crisps, sandwiches)
  • Safety equipment and life jackets
  • Spanish IVA (21%) – no surprises

Fishing grounds off Marbella

The Mediterranean here is rich with pelagic fish. Depending on the season, you can target bonito, dorado, amberjack, and even bluefin tuna. The skipper will navigate to reefs and drop-offs where fish gather, often within 5-10 nautical miles of the coast. You’ll see the Sierra Blanca mountains behind you as you fight your catch.

The sunset cruise back

As the afternoon wears on, we turn the bow back towards Marbella. The light on La Concha mountain turns pink and orange, and the coastline from Cabopino to Estepona glows in the distance. We’ll cruise slowly past the Golden Mile, and you can sip cava on the foredeck. It’s the perfect end to a day on the water.

Optional stops: swimming and snorkelling

On charters of 6 hours or more, we can anchor at Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés for a swim. The water is crystal clear and often calm. Snorkelling gear is available on request. If you’d rather keep fishing, we’ll simply move to another spot.

How to book

Booking is easy. Use the WhatsApp button on our site to check availability for your preferred date. We’ll confirm the boat, time, and meeting point at Puerto Banús. A 50% deposit secures the booking; the balance is due on the day. For any questions, see our [main charter page](/) or explore other [experiences](/experiences/).
